name: send-only-mac-messages
description: Send direct macOS Messages and transiently verify their delivery status.
long_description: A narrow local MCP server with one outbound tool. It accepts an exact phone number, message body, and required delivery mode. iMessage-only never attempts SMS/RCS; the explicit fallback mode may try SMS/RCS once after an immediate or exactly correlated iMessage failure. It transiently observes only those outgoing statuses and has no conversation, Contacts, chat, attachment, or later status lookup tools.

tools.name: tool_send_message
tools.description: Sends one direct message to an exact phone number through Messages.app using a required explicit delivery mode, then transiently checks its send status. iMessage-only never attempts SMS/RCS. The fallback mode may attempt SMS/RCS once after an immediate or exactly correlated iMessage failure and can duplicate a delayed iMessage. Returns a fixed status without echoing recipient or message content.
